title: A reopened change must be closeable again
description: a reopened change must be closeable again
no_spec_change_rationale: the evidence walk admitted a move between a change's two canonical homes in one direction only, so reopen stranded the change in accepted with finalize refusing permanently and audit reporting passed over it
acceptance_criteria: a change that has been finalized, reopened, re-checked and re-reviewed can be finalized again, producing exactly one archive package and clearing its active workspace; a move of scoped review evidence to any location other than the change's two canonical homes is still refused; the ordinary first close is unchanged
